items.html: I have already informed you above that the three Names AB, SAG, MA, whose spelled-out value is the aforementioned 102, are found in ZA alone, within his aforementioned HGT. For this reason ZA is called “Kate’a” [amputated] after their name: Kate’a is numerically equal to AB, SAG, MA — 75 — for they ascend upward, and their spelled-out value, the 102, goes outward.
